previous_statement: By the compressed-product notation used in def-ha-map, a dot b=Co_{A,C}(ab). The exact compression-dagger identity from lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities, followed by the involution law (ab)^dagger=b^dagger a^dagger, gives (a dot b)^dagger=Co_{C,A}(b^dagger a^dagger)=b^dagger dot a^dagger. The corner membership needed in the last product is node 1.2.1; no associativity or estimate is used.
new_statement: Conditional calculation only (and therefore not yet a proof of the reversal assertion in node 1.2): assume the presently unregistered premise that, for compatible a in S_{A,B} and b in S_{B,C}, the compressed product is defined by a dot b := Co_{A,C}(ab). Then lem-compcb-amplified-compression-identities at n=1 and the involution axiom give (a dot b)^dagger = Co_{A,C}(ab)^dagger = Co_{C,A}((ab)^dagger) = Co_{C,A}(b^dagger a^dagger) = b^dagger dot a^dagger; node 1.2.1 supplies the reversed corner memberships. However, neither def-ha-map nor def-hcb-datum nor any registered af definition supplies the assumed formula. Hence the allowed inputs do not currently establish the reversal assertion; the compressed-product definition must first be added to the shard's defs and registered in this workspace.
